method: Recursive original/current condition comparison; every retained arm must have a marker observed in at least one of two actual worker compiler contexts. Excluded arms remain error-only and nested original structure is pruned. For each completed file, original and instrumented compilation include traces were compared in order and matched in both graphs.
limits: Temporary markers and source location may still affect constructs such as __FILE__ or __LINE__; include resolution was verified. These observations prove selected paths only in the two tested graphs; complete supported-context enumeration remains open.
